reviewer: Independent original-pixel, actual-reference and source reviewer

entries.alt: Peter gestures toward a withered fig tree as Jesus listens beside the morning road.
entries.caption: Peter stops beside the dry branches and turns to Jesus. What he has noticed on the road opens a teaching about faith, prayer and forgiveness.
entries.findings: Canonical Christ and apostle reference compared directly. Christ and Peter preserve facial identity, with clear mutual eye contact; Peter's open hand indicates visibly dry lobed fig leaves and branches. James and John behind retain distinct mapped beard/face structures. Photographic skin, blue mantle and morning light. No chopping, fire or magically disappearing fruit; next-morning observation distinct from barren-fig parable.
conditions: Withered branches are visible; roots are not exposed, so do not claim the picture shows root condition. Exact road, skyline, tree shape and ages are interpreted.
Technical pixel/source acceptance is not owner approval or browser verification.
